movement_constants_named_in_gdd.note: Confirmed by reading every paragraph and table cell in Death_Metal_Cat_GDD_v3.docx: Section 4.3 narrates that JumpZVelocity, AirControl, and WallJumpCommitmentDuration previously drifted from their "documented C++ defaults" -- it names these constants but states no numbers itself anywhere in the document. The numeric comparison this agent actually performs is cpp_documented_defaults (DeathMetalCatCharacter.h) vs live_cdo_values (queried below), since that's the real documented baseline the GDD's own text points to.

agent_roster.Role: Writes a short in-character line + sound-bite tag for kill/damage/environment triggers.

[NEW v3] Measures a hand-built golden room once per biome: platform/gap spacing and reachability (jump/wall-jump/dodge, live-queried against the character CDO, never hardcoded), plus 2D sprite scale and HSV color-value consistency across placed instances. Also ingests the GDD's documented movement constants and room-role assumptions, and halts if they mismatch the live-queried values, rather than letting the pipeline proceed on stale numbers.
agent_roster.Input: Golden room level asset, GDD (read once, passed downstream as structured data)
agent_roster.Status: Proven — built, committed, hash-verified on Room1/AssassinCity

agent_roster.Role: [UPDATED v3, replaces old Room Geometry Designer generation step] Composes a new room's platforming layout and 2D dressing by drawing on biome_spec.json's measured spacing/reachability rules and gdd_reference.json's per-room role, rather than a fixed piece vocabulary. Places enemy/pickup spawn markers within the generated geometry.
agent_roster.Input: biome_spec.json, gdd_reference.json, cataloged asset pool (Asset Cataloger, in progress)
agent_roster.Output: JSON: ordered piece sequence + spawn marker positions + dressing assignments
agent_roster.Status: In progress — 6 test room variations generated on Room1's asset set; full asset-pool-driven generation pending Asset Cataloger

agent_roster.Role: [NEW v3] Independently re-checks every gap in a generated room against biome_spec.json's measured movement constants — the deterministic (non-LLM) validation pass, now run against the new generator's output rather than the retired fixed-vocabulary method's.
agent_roster.Status: Scoped — reuses Foundation Extractor's existing reachability logic as a shared source of truth; build in progress

agent_roster.Role: [NEW v3] Deeper, exploratory checks beyond simple pass/fail reachability: whether a room's validity holds up if movement constants are later retuned, whether a technically-reachable gap requires frame-perfect input rather than a comfortable margin, and other edge cases the reachability formula alone has been shown to miss.

[NEW v3, planned] Scans a folder of biome assets (beyond the fixed set already measured in Room1) and outputs footprint, alignment, layer, and role data per asset, so the Room Variation Generator can draw freely from a growing asset pool rather than a hand-fixed set.

Given a room's difficulty tier and the spawn markers left in the generated geometry, decides what (if anything) populates each marker — enemy type or pickup type — driving an escalating difficulty curve across the run.
agent_roster.Status: Schema designed; script build in progress
